questions.question: If 5x − 7 = 18, what is the value of 2x?
questions.explanation: 5x = 25, so x = 5 and 2x = 10. (This question was missing from the scanned paper, so Humo wrote a similar one.)

questions.question: The graph of the linear function f is shown, where y = f(x). What is the y-intercept of the graph of f?
questions.explanation: The line crosses the y-axis at y = −6, so the y-intercept is (0, −6).

questions.question:
−4|5x + 4| + 2 = −14
What are all solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Subtract 2 and divide by −4 to get |5x + 4| = 4. Then 5x + 4 = 4 gives x = 0, and 5x + 4 = −4 gives x = −8/5.

questions.question: The population of a certain city doubled every 25 years from 1660 to 1760. The population of this city was 208,000 in 1760. What was the population of this city in 1660?
questions.explanation: From 1660 to 1760 is 100 years, or 4 doublings, so the 1660 population was 208,000 / 2^4 = 13,000.

questions.question: Three consecutive even integers are ordered from smallest to largest. 5 times the first integer is at least 9 more than the sum of the second and third integers. What is the minimum possible value of the second integer?
questions.topic: Linear inequalities in one or two variables

questions.question: For the linear function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane has a slope of 28 and passes through the point (0, 0). The function f is defined by f(x) = ax, where a is a constant. What is the value of a?
questions.explanation: The slope is a, so a = 28.

questions.question: One of the two equations in a system of linear equations is y = 9x + 19. The system has infinitely many solutions. If the second equation in this system is y = mx + b, where m and b are constants, what is the value of b?
questions.explanation: Infinitely many solutions means the equations are identical, so m = 9 and b = 19.

questions.question: What is the y−intercept of the graph of y = 5^x + 20 in the xy−plane?
If 48x = 6x, what is the value of 6x2?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by x: 48 = 6x^2.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (9nr<sup>2</sup> + 3nr) + (6n<sup>2r</sup> + 5nr)?
questions.explanation: Only the nr terms are like terms: 3nr + 5nr = 8nr. The result is 9nr² + 6n²r + 8nr.

questions.question: The expression x2 + kx + 55, where k is a constant, can be rewritten as (x + n)(x + 11), where n is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: The constant terms multiply to 55, so 11n = 55 and n = 5. Then k = n + 11 = 16.

questions.question: b2 + 4c = 7d. The given equation relates the real numbers b, c, and d, where d > 47c. Which equation correctly expresses b in terms of c and d?
questions.explanation: Subtract 4c: b² = 7d − 4c. Taking the square root gives b = ±√(7d − 4c), which is real because d > 4c/7.

questions.question: The exponential function f is defined by f(x) = ab<sup>x</sup>, where a and b are positive constants. If f(s) = t and f(s + 1) = t − 0.87t, where s and t are constants, what is the value of b?
A scientist analyzed a soil sample with a mass of 900 grams and determined that it contained 189 grams of water. What is the percentage of water, by mass, in this soil sample?

An online bookstore is running a promotion where a paperback book costs $8 and shipping is a flat rate of $4 per order, regardless of how many books are purchased. If a customer's total bill is $68, how many paperback books did the customer purchase?

questions.explanation: The smallest value that appears in the data set is 13 (the frequencies are counts, not values).

questions.question: At a convention center, there are a total of 375 visitors. Each visitor is located in either room A, room B, or room C. If one of these visitors is selected at random, the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room A is 0.68, and the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room B is 0.24. How many visitors are located in room C?
The ratio 36 to m is equivalent to the ratio 2 to 12. What is the value of m?
questions.topic: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units

questions.question: A rectangle has an area of 48 square meters and a length of 12 meters. What is the width, in meters, of the rectangle?
questions.explanation: Width = area ÷ length = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 meters.

questions.question: A city has an area of x square miles and a population density of 1,035 people per square mile. The suburb adjacent to the city has an area of y square miles and a population density of 535 people per square mile. The combined population of the city and the suburb adjacent to the city is 13,165 people. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Population = density × area, so the city has 1,035x people and the suburb 535y; together 1,035x + 535y = 13,165.

questions.question: A research manager selected 2 random samples of ovens of a certain type to estimate the average amount of time this type of oven takes to preheat to 325 degrees Fahrenheit (°F). The research manager recorded the amount of time, in minutes, each oven takes to preheat to 325°F. Based on the first sample, the research manager estimated that this type of oven takes an average of 14.3 minutes to preheat to 325°F, with an associated margin of error of 1 minute. Based on the second sample, the research manager estimated that this type of oven takes an average of 14.5 minutes to preheat to 325°F, with an associated margin of error of 2.1 minutes. Assuming the margins of error were calculated the same way, which of the following best explains why the first sample obtained a smaller margin of error than the second sample?
options: The first sample contained fewer ovens than the second sample.
The first sample contained more ovens than the second sample.
The first sample took less time on average to preheat to 325°F than the second sample.
The first sample took more time on average to preheat to 325°F than the second sample.
questions.explanation: A larger sample gives a smaller margin of error.

questions.question: Circle A in the xy-plane has the equation (x + 8)<sup>2</sup> + (y − 8)<sup>2</sup> = 4. Circle B has the same center as circle A. The radius of circle B is two times the radius of circle A. The equation defining circle B in the xy-plane is (x + 8)<sup>2</sup> + (y − 8)<sup>2</sup> = k, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Circle A has radius 2, so B has radius 4 and k = 4² = 16.

questions.question: If 8(x + 3) = 64, what is the value of x + 3?
questions.explanation: Divide both sides by 8: x + 3 = 8.

questions.question: Line r is defined by the equation 6x − 5y = 6. Line s is parallel to line r in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line s?
questions.explanation: 5y = 6x − 6, so y = (6/5)x − 6/5. Parallel lines have equal slopes: 6/5.

questions.question:
g(m) = −0.05m + 14.1

The given function g models the number of gallons of gasoline that remains from a full gas tank in a car after driving m miles. According to the model, about how many gallons of gasoline are used to drive each mile?

The shaded region shown represents the solutions to the inequality −18y < c, where c is a constant.
What is the value of c?
questions.explanation: The shaded region is y > −9. −18y < c means y > −c/18, so −c/18 = −9 and c = 162.

questions.question:
−2x + 14px = 42
In the given equation, p is a constant. The equation has no solution. What is the value of p?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as (14p − 2)x = 42. There is no solution when 14p − 2 = 0, so p = 1/7.

questions.question: The function w is defined by w(r) = (1)/(r − 4) − (r − 7)/(−r + 5.25). What is the greatest possible value of r such that w(r) = 0?
questions.explanation: Setting 1/(r − 4) = (r − 7)/(−r + 5.25) and cross-multiplying gives −r + 5.25 = r^2 − 11r + 28, so r^2 − 10r + 22.75 = 0. Then r = (10 ± 3)/2, and the greatest value is 6.5 = 13/2.

questions.question: The population of a certain city doubled every 75 years from 1657 to 1957. The population of this city was 240,000 in 1957. What was the population of this city in 1657?
questions.explanation: From 1657 to 1957 is 300 years = 4 doublings, so the 1657 population is 240,000 / 2⁴ = 15,000.

questions.question: What is the y−intercept of the graph of y = 6^x + 12 in the xy−plane?
questions.explanation: At x = 0, y = 6^0 + 12 = 1 + 12 = 13, so the intercept is (0, 13).

questions.question: x(x − 15) = 34. What is the positive solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: x^2 − 15x − 34 = 0 factors as (x − 17)(x + 2) = 0, so the positive solution is 17.

questions.question: In the xy−plane, the graph of the equation y = −x2 + 7x − 80 intersects the line y = c at exactly one point. What is the value of c?
questions.explanation: The line meets the downward parabola at one point only at the vertex. At x = 7/2, y = −49/4 + 49/2 − 80 = −271/4.

An object is launched into the air from ground level. According to a quadratic model, 2.1 seconds after the object is launched, it reaches its maximum height of 70.56 feet above ground level. Which equation represents this model, where f(t) is the object's height, in feet, above ground level t seconds after it was launched?
questions.explanation: Vertex form with vertex (2.1, 70.56) and a maximum (negative leading coefficient): f(t) = −16(t − 2.1)^2 + 70.56.

questions.question:
18x2 + 24x + c = 0
In the given equation, c is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. What is the value of c?
questions.explanation: One solution means the discriminant is zero: 24² − 4(18)c = 576 − 72c = 0, so c = 8.

questions.question:
f(x) = 28(1.30)x/4
For the given function f, the value of f(x) increases by p% for every increase of x by 8. What is the value of p?
questions.explanation: An increase of 8 in x multiplies f by 1.30² = 1.69, an increase of 69%.

questions.question:
The table shows the distribution of people in a certain city by age group.
Age groupProportion
Less than 18 years old28%
18–40 years old24%
41–65 years old22%
Greater than 65 years old26%

If a person in this city is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a person who is greater than 65 years old, given that the person is at least 18 years old?
questions.explanation: People at least 18 make up 24% + 22% + 26% = 72%, so the probability is 26/72 ≈ 0.36.

questions.question: To study fluctuations in leaf water potential, samples of wood were taken from 22 trees and cut in the shape of a cube. The length of the edge of one of these cubes is 3.000 centimeters. This cube has a density of 0.250 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass of this cube, in grams?
questions.explanation: Volume = 3^3 = 27 cm^3, so mass = 27 × 0.250 = 6.75 grams.

questions.question: The volume of a right rectangular prism with a square base is 539 cubic centimeters. If the area of each of the four lateral faces is 77 square centimeters, what is the height, in centimeters, of the prism?
questions.explanation: With base side s and height h, s·h = 77 and s^2·h = 539. Dividing gives s = 7, so h = 77/7 = 11.

A square map has a side length of 45 inches, and 1 inch on the map represents an actual distance of 13 miles. A smaller version of the same map is printed as a square with the side length 70% shorter than the side length of the previous map. On the smaller map, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in miles, represented by 1 inch?
questions.explanation: The original map covers 45 × 13 = 585 miles per side. The smaller side is 0.30 × 45 = 13.5 inches, so 1 inch represents 585/13.5 ≈ 43.33 miles.
